    StartersFranco's housewarming bruschettaCharred sourdough with tomato, basil, buffalo mozzarella and balsamicHow to make it400g cherry tomatoes4 tbsp olive oil2 garlic cloves1 bunch basil1 sourdough loaf2 buffalo mozzarella balls1 bottle balsamic glazeQuarter the tomatoes and toss with some oil, one crushed garlic clove, torn basil and salt.Leave the tomatoes to sit.Slice the sourdough, brush with oil and grill until charred.Rub each warm slice with a cut garlic clove.Top with the tomatoes and pieces of mozzarella, drizzle with balsamic glaze and add a basil leaf.Rationed pretzels with beer cheese dipPretzel bites with beer cheese dip, strictly rationedHow to make it500g pizza dough2 L water60g bicarbonate of soda1 egg, beaten1 tsp sea salt flakes20g butter1 tbsp plain flour150ml lager100ml full cream milk200g cheddar, grated1 tsp American mustard1/2 tsp paprikaCut the dough into bite-size pieces.Simmer the water with the bicarbonate of soda and drop the pieces in briefly, in batches. Drain.Lay on a lined tray, brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220°C.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the lager and milk.Add the cheddar, mustard and paprika and stir until smooth.MainsDanny's big breakfast fry-upEggs, bacon, sausages, hash browns, mushrooms and tomato with toastHow to make it8 frozen hash browns8 pork sausages8 rashers of bacon4 tomatoes, halved250g mushrooms, sliced60g butter1 garlic clove, crushed8 eggs8 slices of thick white bread1 bottle tomato sauceBake the hash browns at 220°C until crisp.Fry the sausages over medium heat.Fry the bacon until crisp, keeping the fat in the pan.Fry the tomatoes cut-side down. Fry the mushrooms in some of the butter with the garlic.Fry the eggs in the bacon fat.Toast the bread and butter it well. Load up plates and serve with tomato sauce.Franco's housewarming hot honey pizzaPepperoni, mozzarella and hot honey, before the sinkhole opensHow to make it2 balls of pizza dough, about 250g each200g tomato passata1 garlic clove, crushed250g mozzarella, torn120g sliced pepperoni3 tbsp honey1 tsp chilli flakes1 small bunch basilWarm the honey with the chilli flakes and leave to infuse.Heat the oven as high as it goes with a tray or stone inside. Mix the passata with the garlic and salt.Stretch each dough thin on baking paper, spread with sauce and top with mozzarella and pepperoni.Slide onto the hot tray and bake until blistered.Drizzle with the hot honey and tear over basil.SweetsThat's my Milky Way, homemade nougat barsNougat, caramel and milk chocolate. Don't touch it, Jonah.How to make it200g marshmallows40g butter3 tbsp malted milk powder1 tsp vanilla extract200g soft caramels2 tbsp thickened cream250g milk chocolate1 tsp vegetable oilMelt the marshmallows with the butter, stir in the malted milk powder and vanilla, and press into a lined 20cm square tin.Melt the caramels with the cream until smooth and spread over the nougat.Chill.Melt the chocolate with the oil and pour over the top.Chill until set, then cut into bars with a hot knife.DrinksRationed water watermelon agua frescaWatermelon, lime and mint, cold.
